{{Quote|Kamori's Zethusian plains were shaken by tremendous quakes this week, which caused serious damage to Jandal, Hyra, and Kimora City, and resulted in several hundred thousand deaths.|A news report by Hypermedia Galactic News Service|<ref name="GNN" />}}
'''Kamori''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. Its most accomplished [[Artist/Legends|artists]] were sometimes awarded the title of [["Living treasure"|"living treasure"]], which was granted to the [[Glanthe]] painter [[Dana Dregond]] around [[10 BBY/Legends|10 BBY]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the [[Zethusian plains]] on Kamori were struck by a series of powerful [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]]. They resulted in the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of several hundred thousand people and extensive damage to three [[City/Legends|cities]] in the area.

==Description==
{{Quote|Further damage was done to outlying coastal areas by tidal waves generated by the quakes.|A news report by Hypermedia Galactic News Service|<ref name="GNN" />}}
Kamori was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="GNN" /> located in the [[Kamori system/Legends|Kamori system]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA" /> Its surface featured coastal areas.<ref name="GNN" />

==History==
{{Quote|Among the dead was Glanthe master Dana Dregond ''[&hellip;]''. She was designated 10 years ago as one of Kamori's "living treasures," an honor sparingly accorded to the world's most accomplished masters of the arts.|A news report by Hypermedia Galactic News Service|<ref name="GNN" />}}
Around [[10 BBY/Legends|10 BBY]],<ref name="10 BBY">The news report in {{JournalCite|5|Galaxywide NewsNets}} stating that [[Dana Dregond]] was awarded the title of [["Living treasure"|"living treasure"]] [[Standard decade/Legends|ten years]] prior is set on the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] "36:2:4," which corresponds to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] per the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]]. Per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', that means Dregond was awarded the title around [[10 BBY/Legends|10 BBY]].</ref> the [[Glanthe]] [[Artist/Legends|painter]] [[Dana Dregond]], who was widely regarded as [[Glanthe school]]'s premiere artist in Kamori's [[Sector/Legends|sector]], was awarded Kamori's honorary title of [["Living treasure"|"living treasure"]]. [[Standard decade/Legends|Ten years later]], a series of powerful [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]] occurred in Kamori's [[Zethusian plains]] region. They resulted in the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of several hundred thousand people, including Dregond, and caused significant damage to three [[City/Legends|cities]] in the area. In addition, [[Ocean/Legends|tidal waves]] caused by the quakes led to further damage to outlying coastal areas.<ref name="GNN" />

In response, Kamori's [[Chamber President]] [[Thane Dregond]] declared the area affected by the quakes to be eligible for government disaster relief and petitioned the world's [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]] for additional relief funds. On the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] [[0 ABY/Legends|36:2:4]], within a [[Standard week/Legends|week]] of the disaster, the groundquakes on Kamori were covered in a news report by [[Hypermedia Galactic News Service]], issued from [[Tandaro]] on Kamori.<ref name="GNN" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Quote|Chamber President Thane Dregond declared the disaster area eligible for government disaster relief, and is petitioning the governor for Imperial relief funds as well.|A news report by Hypermedia Galactic News Service|<ref name="GNN" />}}
Kamori's population numbered more than several hundred thousand. During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the Galactic Empire, the world was overseen by an Imperial governor, and the local government administrating the area of the Zethusian plains was led by a Chamber President. "Living treasure" was an honor rarely bestowed upon Kamori's most accomplished artists.<ref name="GNN" />

==Locations==
{{Quote|Direct damage from the quakes all but dismantled the transportation infrastructure in both Hyra and Kimora, and several areas of the three cities are still without running water and power.|A news report by Hypermedia Galactic News Service|<ref name="GNN" />}}
Kamori was the site of the location known as the Zethusian plains, which hosted the cities [[Hyra]], [[Jandal]], and [[Kimora City]]. The location Tandaro was also situated on Kamori.<ref name="GNN" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kamori was introduced by [[Paul Sudlow]] in the "[[Galaxywide NewsNets]]" feature of the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 5|fifth issue]] of [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'', which was published in [[February]] [[1995]].<ref name="GNN" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Kamori [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the world itself, in grid square M-11.<ref name="TEA" />
